questions.question: What percentage of uninsured women aged 40 to 64 reported having a mammogram within the past 2 years in 2019?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_mammography_use.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
col_2019 = [c for c in range(df.shape[1]) if str(df.iloc[3, c]).strip() == '2019'][0]

uninsured_val = None
for r in range(len(df)):
    if str(df.iloc[r, 0]).strip() == 'Uninsured':
        uninsured_val = float(df.iloc[r, col_2019])
        break

result = uninsured_val

questions.question: In 2019, which age group had a higher mammography rate: women aged 50–64 years or women aged 65–74 years?
questions.check_program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_mammography_use.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
header = df.iloc[3]
col_2019 = header[header.astype(str).str.contains('2019')].index[0]

# Locate the rows for 50–64 years and 65–74 years under Age group (rows 10-16)
row_50_64 = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == '50–64 years'].index[0]
row_65_74 = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == '65–74 years'].index[0]

val_50_64 = float(df.iloc[row_50_64, col_2019])
val_65_74 = float(df.iloc[row_65_74, col_2019])

result = str(df.iloc[row_65_74, 0]).strip() if val_65_74 > val_50_64 else str(df.iloc[row_50_64, 0]).strip()

questions.question: In which survey year did the age-adjusted percentage of women aged 40 and over who received a mammogram in the past two years reach its peak?
questions.check_program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_mammography_use.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
header = df.iloc[3]
# Row for Total, 40 years and over, age adjusted
row_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Total, 40 years and over, age adjusted')].index[0]

rates = {}
for col_idx in range(1, len(header), 2):
    yr = str(header[col_idx]).strip()
    val = pd.to_numeric(df.iloc[row_idx, col_idx], errors='coerce')
    if pd.notna(val):
        rates[yr] = val

result = max(rates, key=rates.get)

questions.question: In 2019, was the mammogram screening rate among women aged 40 and over with some college education or more higher than 70%?

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_mammography_use.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)

rate = None
for r in range(81, 86):
    if 'Some college or more' in str(df.iloc[r, 0]):
        rate = float(df.iloc[r, col_2019])
        break

result = "yes" if rate > 70 else "no"

questions.question: Among women aged 40 and over by poverty level, which two income categories had the highest mammography screening rates in 2019?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_mammography_use.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
col_2019 = [c for c in range(df.shape[1]) if str(df.iloc[3, c]).strip() == '2019'][0]

poverty_rates = {}
for r in range(55, 59):
    cat = str(df.iloc[r, 0]).strip()
    poverty_rates[cat] = float(df.iloc[r, col_2019])

sorted_cats = sorted(poverty_rates, key=poverty_rates.get, reverse=True)
result = sorted_cats[:2]

questions.question: In 2018, by how many percentage points did the mammography rate for women aged 40–64 with private health insurance exceed that of uninsured women in the same age group?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_mammography_use.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
col_2018 = [c for c in range(df.shape[1]) if str(df.iloc[3, c]).strip() == '2018'][0]

private_rate = None
uninsured_rate = None
for r in range(75, 81):
    cell = str(df.iloc[r, 0]).strip()
    if cell == 'Private':
        private_rate = float(df.iloc[r, col_2018])
    elif cell == 'Uninsured':
        uninsured_rate = float(df.iloc[r, col_2018])

result = round(private_rate - uninsured_rate, 1)
